# Bad product name

When using the product class function getProductName and including the feature id parameter.
it uses this SQL
`$query->select('IFNULL(CONCAT(pl.name, \' : \', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT agl.`name`, \' - \', al.name SEPARATOR \', \')),pl.name) as name');`

instead of 
`$query->select('IFNULL(CONCAT(pl.name, \' : \', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT agl.`public_name`, \' - \', al.name SEPARATOR \', \')),pl.name) as name');`

So the name returns the internal name of the group and not the expected public one.

## Attendu
The name returned should be using the public values not the internal ones.

## Étapes
1. go the attribute groups in the BO
2. set different values on name and public name for a group like color.
3. run the code Product::getProductName($id_product, $id_product_attribute, $id_lang); for a product with color, you will get the wrong name.
